t: Ronseal Ultimate Protection Slate Anti-Slip Decking Stain provides comprehensive defence for outdoor wooden decking against harsh weather conditions and daily use. This high-performance, water-based decking stain is ideal for busy patios and garden decks, ensuring a safe and long-lasting finish for any outdoor timber project. It offers weatherproof, scuff, scratch, and anti-slip resistance, maintaining structural integrity and appearance. The stain is touch-dry in just 90 minutes and can be recoated in 4 hours, facilitating efficient project completion. A 2.5Ltr tin provides coverage for approximately 20 square metres, ensuring value and durability for trade applications.
